name: Home Assistant
description: Read entity states, call services, fire events and send phone notifications through Home Assistant
summary: Home Assistant REST calls from a workflow. Built from the LeForge usertasks-connectors repository.
setup_notes: Packaged for one Home Assistant server (npm run package -- home_assistant --url <server URL>). Set the secret "api_token" on the Access tab: A long-lived access token. Create it on your Profile page > Security > Long-lived access tokens > Create token. A long-lived access token from a dedicated user A user that can control only the entities the workflows need
author: LeForge
